description: A shell script defining tests for git remerge-diff functionality, including setup, merging, conflict resolution, and output verification.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes a sequence of lines to a specified file index.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of enclosed commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the enclosed command fails.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
